rows: Okay, here is the honest bit. I want to show you the air, and then I want you to believe it.
I can brawl too, I promise. It is just not the first thing I want you to see.
Risk? Yes. That is the whole point of me, and I am proud of it.
Taking it slow is hard for me, honestly. I like to fly, so I will do it when it counts.
The people give me my energy. Give them something to remember and I will give you the rest.
I am excited, and I am here to show you why.
I want the top spot, but I want to earn it in the air, not by standing still.
Look at the stance! Feel it! It is ready to go, and I cannot wait.
You are so into technique! I think you will see mine in the air, so keep your eyes up.
Strikes are good. But the best bit is the moment before the landing.
Risk is the fun part, and it can go wrong. I know that. I still want it.
Stalling is not my speed. I like to move and keep the people guessing.
The people want to feel the moment before it happens. Let us give them that.
You call me a sideshow. Fine. Watch what the sideshow does at the top of the rope.
Proud of your {strength}? Good! Right, let's go! I like a challenge I can climb over.
I have seen your {strength}, and I want to find the moment where it gives a little.
You were steady, brilliant! Right, let's go! I am the one who gets excited, so I will go first.
Agreed, for now, yes! We agree, and I am happy about that.
I could go mad about it. I will channel that into the match instead.
Just one fall, brilliant! Keep me down, and I will say it was brilliant.
On the mat I will stay low and quick, and you will have to keep up.
Grounded or standing, I will find a way to make it exciting.
Stay in front of me, and I will show you what I mean.
Brilliant answer! I am going to watch you carefully now.
You have not answered yet. Come on, you can do it.
Agreed, for now, yes! I will take that and put it in my next move.
Fair point, I love that! I cannot wait for the bell.
I am going to give everything I have until the bell, and I will enjoy every second.
My plan is big air, simple! Bring the energy and keep the risk calculated.
Whatever happens, I want you to know I gave it everything.
The result is still open, and I am happy with that.
I have one more idea. Watch when the bell goes.
Wait, you're right to ask! I can't point to anything that proves it. Let's get to the part we can actually show them.
I got a bit ahead of myself there. I haven't got an example, so let's leave that out and have a match!
Good! That's clearer. Now we've got something we can do, rather than something to argue about.
Right, no need to keep pulling at that. Come on, let's see what we can actually do.
Keep your eyes on the landing! If I can make it count, everyone will see it.
They'll see if I can turn all that energy into a result. That's what I'm excited to find out.
Okay, forget the allegation. What can we actually show these people when we get moving?
I want them to see it, not just hear about it. What can we prove to them in the ring?
Yes! You've worked out an answer to my {strength}. Now let's see how it feels when we actually get moving.
You know what to expect from my {strength}. Brilliant. I want to find the moment when you stop expecting it.
Yes, fair! Let's give them something they can see instead of asking them to take our word for it.
Okay, I hear you. We can make the wrestling real without making the rumour real.
